proposals.evidence: Perder explicitly proposes, with probably, that nitē lest arose from ni not plus tē that. His example 138 illustrates an undesirable consequence after an instruction, explaining the negative complementizer meaning. Both components are independently attested and have reviewed links; the present proposal represents the lexical combination, retaining the source’s uncertainty about historical formation rather than asserting a new inherited root or borrowing.
